# New categorize
```{r}
categorize_h0_new <- function (dataInput,parameterVectorSigmoidal, parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal, 
    threshold_intensity_range = 0.1, threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum = 0.3, 
    threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC = 0, threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio = 0.85, 
    threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio = 0.75, threshold_AIC = -10, 
    threshold_t0_max_int = 1e+10, showDetails = FALSE) 
{
    decisionList <- list()

    if ((!is.na(parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName)) & (!is.na(parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataInputName))) {
        decisionList$test.name <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName == 
            parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataInputName
        decisionList$dataInputName <- as.vector(parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName)
    }
else {
        decisionList$test.name <- NA
        decisionList$dataInputName <- NA
    }
    

# F-tests for sigmoidal

F_reject_sigmoid<-0
F_reject_double<-0
sigmoid_classic_fail<-0
sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail<-0
double_classic_fail<-0
double_lack_of_fit_fail<-0
sigmoid_AIC_fail<-0
double_AIC_fail<-0


group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarise(average = mean(intensity),reps = n(),.groups = 'drop')

    if(!is.null(parameterVectorSigmoidal)){

        decisionList$test.name <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName == 
            parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataInputName
        decisionList$dataInputName <- as.vector(parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName)


  sigmoid_fitted_values <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate,

    slopeParam =
      parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate,

    midPoint =
      parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate,

    h0=parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate
  )





  sigmoid_residuals <-
    dataInput$intensity - sigmoid_fitted_values

  sigmoid_df<-nrow(dataInput)-4



flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-nrow(dataInput)-1

Flat_sigmoid_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-sigmoid_df))/(sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)/sigmoid_df)

F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(Flat_sigmoid_stat,flat_df-sigmoid_df,sigmoid_df,lower.tail=FALSE)

if(F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value>0.01){
  F_reject_sigmoid<-1
  sigmoid_classic_fail<-1
}

total_error<-sum(sigmoid_residuals^2)

pure_error<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))

alternative_lack_of_fit<-total_error-pure_error


  sigmoid_fitted_unique <- sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate,
    slopeParam = parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate,
    midPoint = parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate,
    h0 = parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2<-sum(group_summary$reps*(sigmoid_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)


  lack_of_fit_df<- length(group_summary$time)-4 
  pure_error_df<- nrow(dataInput)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2/lack_of_fit_df)/(pure_error/pure_error_df)
  lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<-pf(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,lack_of_fit_df,pure_error_df, lower.tail=FALSE)




if(lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value<0.05){
  F_reject_sigmoid<-1
  sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail<-1
}

if(parameterVectorSigmoidal$AIC>5){
sigmoid_AIC_fail<-1
}

sigmoidalModel.AIC<-parameterVectorSigmoidal$AIC
sigmoid_max_estimate<-parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate
sigmoid_slopeParam_estimate<-parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate
sigmoid_midpoint_estimate<-parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate
sigmoid_h0_estimate<-parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate

decisionList$Flat_sigmoid_stat <- Flat_sigmoid_stat
decisionList$F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value <- F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value


decisionList$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat <- lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat
decisionList$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value <- lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value

decisionList$F_reject_sigmoid <- F_reject_sigmoid

decisionList$sigmoid_classic_fail <- sigmoid_classic_fail
decisionList$sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail <- sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail

decisionList$sigmoid_AIC_fail <- sigmoid_AIC_fail



}

else{
sigmoid_max_estimate<-NA
sigmoid_slopeParam_estimate<-NA
sigmoid_midpoint_estimate<-NA
sigmoid_h0_estimate<-NA
decisionList$F_Flat_sigmoid_stat <- NA
decisionList$F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value <- NA
decisionList$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat <- NA
decisionList$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value <- NA
decisionList$F_reject_sigmoid <- NA
decisionList$sigmoid_classic_fail <- NA
decisionList$sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail <- NA
decisionList$sigmoid_AIC_fail <- NA
}

# F-tests for double sigmoidal

if(!is.null(parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal)){
ds_fitted_values<-doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = dataInput$time,
    maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate,

    slope1Param =
      parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate,

    midPoint1Param =
      parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate,

    slope2Param=parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate,

    midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,

    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio=parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,

    h0=parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)

ds_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-ds_fitted_values

ds_df<-nrow(dataInput)-7

flat_line<-mean(dataInput$intensity)

flat_residuals<-dataInput$intensity-flat_line

flat_df<-nrow(dataInput)-1

Flat_ds_stat<-(((sum(flat_residuals^2)-sum(ds_residuals^2)))/(flat_df-ds_df))/(sum(ds_residuals^2)/ds_df)
  

F_Flat_ds_p_value<-pf(Flat_ds_stat,flat_df-ds_df,ds_df,lower.tail=FALSE)

if(!is.null(F_Flat_ds_p_value)){
if(F_Flat_ds_p_value>0.01){
  F_reject_double<-1
  double_classic_fail<-1
}}





pure_error_ds<-sum(ave(
    dataInput$intensity,
    dataInput$time,
    FUN = function(x) (x - mean(x))^2))


  ds_fitted_unique <- doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
    x = group_summary$time,
    maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate,
    slope1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate,
    midPoint1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate,
    slope2Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate,
    midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,
    finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,
    h0 = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate
  )


  lack_of_fit_2_ds<-sum(group_summary$reps*(ds_fitted_unique-group_summary$average)^2)

  lack_of_fit_df_ds<-length(group_summary$time)-7
  pure_error_df_ds<-nrow(dataInput)-length(group_summary$time)

  lack_of_fit_ds_stat<-(lack_of_fit_2_ds/lack_of_fit_df_ds)/(pure_error_ds/ pure_error_df_ds)
  lack_of_fit_ds_p_value <- pf(lack_of_fit_ds_stat, lack_of_fit_df_ds, pure_error_df_ds, lower.tail = FALSE)

if(!is.null(lack_of_fit_ds_p_value)){
if(lack_of_fit_ds_p_value<0.05){
  F_reject_double<-1
  double_lack_of_fit_fail<-1
}}

if(!is.null(parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal)){
if(parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$AIC>5){
    double_AIC_fail<-1
}}

doubleSigmoidalModel.AIC<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$AIC
ds_max_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_Estimate
    ds_slope1Param_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate
    ds_midPoint1Param_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate
    ds_slope2Param_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate
    ds_midPointDistanceParam_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate
    ds_finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate
    ds_h0_estimate<-parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate

decisionList$Flat_ds_stat <- Flat_ds_stat
decisionList$F_Flat_ds_p_value <- F_Flat_ds_p_value
decisionList$lack_of_fit_ds_stat <- lack_of_fit_ds_stat
decisionList$lack_of_fit_ds_p_value <- lack_of_fit_ds_p_value
decisionList$F_reject_double <- F_reject_double
decisionList$double_classic_fail <- double_classic_fail
decisionList$double_lack_of_fit_fail <- double_lack_of_fit_fail
decisionList$double_AIC_fail <- double_AIC_fail

}

else{F_reject_double<-1  
ds_max_estimate<-NA
ds_slope1Param_estimate<-NA
ds_midPoint1Param_estimate<-NA
ds_slope2Param_estimate<-NA
ds_midPointDistanceParam_estimate<-NA
ds_finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_estimate<-NA
ds_h0_estimate<-NA
decisionList$Flat_ds_stat <- NA
decisionList$F_Flat_ds_p_value <- NA
decisionList$lack_of_fit_ds_stat <- NA
decisionList$lack_of_fit_ds_p_value <- NA
decisionList$F_reject_double <- NA
decisionList$double_classic_fail <- NA
decisionList$double_lack_of_fit_fail <- NA
decisionList$double_AIC_fail <- NA

}

    decisionList$test.sm_modelCheck <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$model == 
        "sigmoidal"
    decisionList$test.dsm_modelCheck <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$model == 
        "doublesigmoidal"
    test.timeRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange
    if (test.timeRange) {
        timeRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange
    }
    test.intensityMin <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMin == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMin
    test.intensityMax <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax
    if (test.intensityMax) {
        intensityMax <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax
    }
    test.intensityRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange
    if (test.intensityRange) {
        intensityRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange
    }
    decisionList$test.dataScalingParameters <- test.timeRange & 
        test.intensityMin & test.intensityMax & test.intensityRange
    decisionList$intensityMaximum <- intensityMax
    decisionList$threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum <- threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum
    decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum <- threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum < 
        intensityMax
    decisionList$intensityRange <- intensityRange
    decisionList$threshold_intensity_range <- threshold_intensity_range
    decisionList$test.intensity_range <- threshold_intensity_range < 
        intensityRange
    decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$isThisaFit
    decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalFit <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$isThisaFit
    decisionList$test.sigmoidalAdditionalParameters <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$additionalParameters
    decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAdditionalParameters <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$additionalParameters
    decisionList$threshold_AIC <- threshold_AIC
    decisionList$sigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$AIC_value
    decisionList$test.F_test_sigmoid <- F_reject_sigmoid==0
    decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$AIC_value
    decisionList$test.F_test_ds <- F_reject_double==0
    decisionList$dsm_maximum_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_x
    decisionList$timeRange <- timeRange
    decisionList$test.dsm_maximum_x <- decisionList$dsm_maximum_x < 
        timeRange
    sm_intensity_at_tmax <- sicegar::sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = timeRange, 
        maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y, slopeParam = parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate, 
        midPoint = parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- sm_intensity_at_tmax/parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y
    decisionList$threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$test.sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- decisionList$sm_tmax_IntensityRatio > 
        threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    dsm_intensity_at_tmax <- sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = timeRange, 
        finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate, 
        maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y, slope1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate, 
        midPoint1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate, 
        slope2Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate, 
        midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- dsm_intensity_at_tmax/parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y
    decisionList$threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$test.dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- decisionList$dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio < 
        threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$sm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$startPoint_x
    decisionList$test.sm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$startPoint_x > 
        0
    decisionList$dsm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$startPoint_x
    decisionList$test.dsm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$startPoint_x > 
        0
    decisionList$sm_startIntensity <- sicegar::sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = 0, 
        maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y, slopeParam = parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate, 
        midPoint = parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$threshold_t0_max_int <- threshold_t0_max_int
    decisionList$test.sm_startIntensity <- decisionList$sm_startIntensity < 
        threshold_t0_max_int
    decisionList$dsm_startIntensity <- sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = 0, 
        finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate, 
        maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y, slope1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate, 
        midPoint1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate, 
        slope2Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate, 
        midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$test.dsm_startIntensity <- decisionList$dsm_startIntensity < 
        threshold_t0_max_int
    if (!is.na(decisionList$test.name)) {
        if (!decisionList$test.name) {
            stop("dataNames of sigmoidal and double-sigmoidal fits must be same")
        }
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_modelCheck) {
        stop("provided sigmoidal model must be fitted by sicegar::sigmoidalFitFunction()")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_modelCheck) {
        stop("provided double_sigmoidal model must be fitted by sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFunction()")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dataScalingParameters) {
        stop("data scaling parameters of provided sigmoidal and double_sigmoidal parameterVectors must be same")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalAdditionalParameters) {
        stop("additional parameters for sigmoidal fit must be calculated")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAdditionalParameters) {
        stop("additional parameters for double_sigmoidal fit must be calculated")
    }
    choices <- c("no_signal", "sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
        "ambiguous")
    decisionSteps <- c()
    if (!decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
            "ambiguous"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
            "ambiguous"))
    }
    if (!setequal(choices, c("no_signal"))) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1c")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("no_signal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "2a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "2b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.F_test_sigmoid) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "3a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.F_test_ds) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "3b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_startPoint_x) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "4a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_startPoint_x) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "4b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "6")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_tmax_IntensityRatio) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "7")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (length(intersect(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal"))) > 
        0) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "8")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("ambiguous"))
    }
    if (length(intersect(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal"))) == 
        2) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "9")
        if (decisionList$sigmoidalAIC + threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC < 
            decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC) {
            choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
        }
        if (decisionList$sigmoidalAIC + threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC > 
            decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC) {
            choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
        }
    }
    if (!length(choices) == 1) {
        stop("At this point length of choice must be 1")
    }
    decisionList$decisionSteps <- paste0(decisionSteps, collapse = "_")
    decisionList$decision <- paste0(choices, collapse = "_")
    if (showDetails) {
        utils::str(decisionList)
    }

   print(alternative_lack_of_fit)
   print(lack_of_fit_2)

    return(data.frame(decisionList))
}
```

# OG categorize
```{r}
categorize_h0_og <- function (dataInput,parameterVectorSigmoidal, parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal, 
    threshold_intensity_range = 0.1, threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum = 0.3, 
    threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC = 0, threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio = 0.85, 
    threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio = 0.75, threshold_AIC = -10, 
    threshold_t0_max_int = 1e+10, showDetails = FALSE) 
{
    decisionList <- list()
    if ((!is.na(parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName)) & (!is.na(parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataInputName))) {
        decisionList$test.name <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName == 
            parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataInputName
        decisionList$dataInputName <- as.vector(parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataInputName)
    }
    else {
        decisionList$test.name <- NA
        decisionList$dataInputName <- NA
    }
    decisionList$test.sm_modelCheck <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$model == 
        "sigmoidal"
    decisionList$test.dsm_modelCheck <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$model == 
        "doublesigmoidal"
    test.timeRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange
    if (test.timeRange) {
        timeRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.timeRange
    }
    test.intensityMin <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMin == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMin
    test.intensityMax <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax
    if (test.intensityMax) {
        intensityMax <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityMax
    }
    test.intensityRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange == 
        parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange
    if (test.intensityRange) {
        intensityRange <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$dataScalingParameters.intensityRange
    }
    decisionList$test.dataScalingParameters <- test.timeRange & 
        test.intensityMin & test.intensityMax & test.intensityRange
    decisionList$intensityMaximum <- intensityMax
    decisionList$threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum <- threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum
    decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum <- threshold_minimum_for_intensity_maximum < 
        intensityMax
    decisionList$intensityRange <- intensityRange
    decisionList$threshold_intensity_range <- threshold_intensity_range
    decisionList$test.intensity_range <- threshold_intensity_range < 
        intensityRange
    decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$isThisaFit
    decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalFit <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$isThisaFit
    decisionList$test.sigmoidalAdditionalParameters <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$additionalParameters
    decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAdditionalParameters <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$additionalParameters
    decisionList$threshold_AIC <- threshold_AIC
    decisionList$sigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$AIC_value
    decisionList$test.sigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$AIC_value < 
        threshold_AIC
    decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$AIC_value
    decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAIC <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$AIC_value < 
        threshold_AIC
    decisionList$dsm_maximum_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_x
    decisionList$timeRange <- timeRange
    decisionList$test.dsm_maximum_x <- decisionList$dsm_maximum_x < 
        timeRange
    sm_intensity_at_tmax <- sicegar::sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = timeRange, 
        maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y, slopeParam = parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate, 
        midPoint = parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- sm_intensity_at_tmax/parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y
    decisionList$threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$test.sm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- decisionList$sm_tmax_IntensityRatio > 
        threshold_sm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    dsm_intensity_at_tmax <- sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = timeRange, 
        finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate, 
        maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y, slope1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate, 
        midPoint1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate, 
        slope2Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate, 
        midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- dsm_intensity_at_tmax/parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y
    decisionList$threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$test.dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio <- decisionList$dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio < 
        threshold_dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio
    decisionList$sm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$startPoint_x
    decisionList$test.sm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorSigmoidal$startPoint_x > 
        0
    decisionList$dsm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$startPoint_x
    decisionList$test.dsm_startPoint_x <- parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$startPoint_x > 
        0
    decisionList$sm_startIntensity <- sicegar::sigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = 0, 
        maximum = parameterVectorSigmoidal$maximum_y, slopeParam = parameterVectorSigmoidal$slopeParam_Estimate, 
        midPoint = parameterVectorSigmoidal$midPoint_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$threshold_t0_max_int <- threshold_t0_max_int
    decisionList$test.sm_startIntensity <- decisionList$sm_startIntensity < 
        threshold_t0_max_int
    decisionList$dsm_startIntensity <- sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(x = 0, 
        finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate, 
        maximum = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$maximum_y, slope1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope1Param_Estimate, 
        midPoint1Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPoint1Param_Estimate, 
        slope2Param = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$slope2Param_Estimate, 
        midPointDistanceParam = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate, 
        h0 = parameterVectorDoubleSigmoidal$h0_Estimate)
    decisionList$test.dsm_startIntensity <- decisionList$dsm_startIntensity < 
        threshold_t0_max_int
    if (!is.na(decisionList$test.name)) {
        if (!decisionList$test.name) {
            stop("dataNames of sigmoidal and double-sigmoidal fits must be same")
        }
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_modelCheck) {
        stop("provided sigmoidal model must be fitted by sicegar::sigmoidalFitFunction()")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_modelCheck) {
        stop("provided double_sigmoidal model must be fitted by sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFunction()")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dataScalingParameters) {
        stop("data scaling parameters of provided sigmoidal and double_sigmoidal parameterVectors must be same")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalAdditionalParameters) {
        stop("additional parameters for sigmoidal fit must be calculated")
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAdditionalParameters) {
        stop("additional parameters for double_sigmoidal fit must be calculated")
    }
    choices <- c("no_signal", "sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
        "ambiguous")
    decisionSteps <- c()
    if (!decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
            "ambiguous"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.minimum_for_intensity_maximum) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal", 
            "ambiguous"))
    }
    if (!setequal(choices, c("no_signal"))) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "1c")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("no_signal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "2a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalFit) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "2b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sigmoidalAIC) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "3a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.doublesigmoidalAIC) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "3b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_startPoint_x) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "4a")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_startPoint_x) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "4b")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.dsm_tmax_IntensityRatio) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "6")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (!decisionList$test.sm_tmax_IntensityRatio) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "7")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
    }
    if (length(intersect(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal"))) > 
        0) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "8")
        choices <- setdiff(choices, c("ambiguous"))
    }
    if (length(intersect(choices, c("sigmoidal", "double_sigmoidal"))) == 
        2) {
        decisionSteps <- c(decisionSteps, "9")
        if (decisionList$sigmoidalAIC + threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC < 
            decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC) {
            choices <- setdiff(choices, c("double_sigmoidal"))
        }
        if (decisionList$sigmoidalAIC + threshold_bonus_sigmoidal_AIC > 
            decisionList$doublesigmoidalAIC) {
            choices <- setdiff(choices, c("sigmoidal"))
        }
    }
    if (!length(choices) == 1) {
        stop("At this point length of choice must be 1")
    }
    decisionList$decisionSteps <- paste0(decisionSteps, collapse = "_")
    decisionList$decision <- paste0(choices, collapse = "_")
    if (showDetails) {
        utils::str(decisionList)
    }


    return(decisionList)
}

```

# Test

```{r}
get_gene<-function(csv,gene){
    csv|>
        filter(geneName==gene)|>
        select(time,intensity)
}
```

```{r}
decision<-function(data,gene,flipped=0){

F_reject_sigmoid<-0
F_reject_double<-0
sigmoid_classic_fail<-0
sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail<-0
double_classic_fail<-0
double_lack_of_fit_fail<-0
sigmoid_AIC_fail<-0
double_AIC_fail<-0
F_differs_from_AIC<-1

graph_list<-list()


if(flipped==0){
dataInput<-get_gene(data,gene)}

else{
    dataInput<-data
}

group_summary<-dataInput|>
  group_by(time)|>
  summarise(average = mean(intensity),reps = n(),.groups = 'drop')

normalizedInput <- normalizeData(dataInput = dataInput)


sigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "sigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)




sigmoidalModel <-tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(sigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)


doubleSigmoidalModel<-tryCatch(multipleFitFunction_h0(dataInput = normalizedInput,
                                          model = "doublesigmoidal",
                                          n_runs_min = 20,
                                          n_runs_max = 500,
                                          showDetails = FALSE),error=function(e) NULL)

doubleSigmoidalModel <- tryCatch(parameterCalculation_h0(doubleSigmoidalModel),error=function(e) NULL)

if (is.null(sigmoidalModel)||is.null(doubleSigmoidalModel)){
    if (isTRUE(flipped==0 && mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time==0], na.rm=TRUE) > mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time==max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)], na.rm=TRUE))){
      dataInput$time<-max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)-dataInput$time
      return(decision(dataInput,gene,flipped=1))
    }
    return(data.frame(
      final_og.decision = "ambiguous",
      final_new.decision = "failed_to_fit",
      test.F_test_sigmoid = NA, test.F_test_ds = NA,
      sigmoid_AIC = NA, ds_AIC = NA,
      Flat_sigmoid_stat = NA, F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value = NA,
      lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat = NA, lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value = NA,
      F_reject_sigmoid = NA, sigmoid_classic_fail = NA,
      sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail = NA, sigmoid_AIC_fail = NA,
      Flat_ds_stat = NA, F_Flat_ds_p_value = NA,
      lack_of_fit_ds_stat = NA, lack_of_fit_ds_p_value = NA,
      F_reject_double = NA, double_classic_fail = NA,
      double_lack_of_fit_fail = NA, double_AIC_fail = NA,
      flipped = flipped
    ))
  }

  if (is.null(sigmoidalModel)||is.null(doubleSigmoidalModel)){
    return(data.frame(
      final_og.decision = "ambiguous",
      final_new.decision = "failed_to_fit",
      test.F_test_sigmoid = NA, test.F_test_ds = NA,
      sigmoid_AIC = NA, ds_AIC = NA,
      Flat_sigmoid_stat = NA, F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value = NA,
      lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat = NA, lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value = NA,
      F_reject_sigmoid = NA, sigmoid_classic_fail = NA,
      sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail = NA, sigmoid_AIC_fail = NA,
      Flat_ds_stat = NA, F_Flat_ds_p_value = NA,
      lack_of_fit_ds_stat = NA, lack_of_fit_ds_p_value = NA,
      F_reject_double = NA, double_classic_fail = NA,
      double_lack_of_fit_fail = NA, double_AIC_fail = NA,
      flipped = flipped
    ))
  }


final_og<-categorize_h0_og(dataInput,sigmoidalModel,doubleSigmoidalModel)


final_new<-categorize_h0_new(dataInput,sigmoidalModel,doubleSigmoidalModel)

if (isTRUE(mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time == 0], na.rm=TRUE) > mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time == max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)], na.rm=TRUE) && final_og$decision=='ambiguous')){
dataInput$time<-max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)-dataInput$time
flipped<-1
return(decision(dataInput,gene,flipped=1))}


if (isTRUE(mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time == 0], na.rm=TRUE) > mean(dataInput$intensity[dataInput$time == max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)], na.rm=TRUE) && final_new$decision=='ambiguous')){
dataInput$time<-max(dataInput$time, na.rm=TRUE)-dataInput$time
flipped<-1
return(decision(dataInput,gene,flipped=1))
}


if(isTRUE(final_og$decision==final_new$decision && final_og$decision=="sigmoidal")){
fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  sigmoidalModel,
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s",final_og$decision))}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision==final_new$decision && final_og$decision=="double_sigmoidal")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  doubleSigmoidalFitVector = doubleSigmoidalModel,
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s",final_og$decision))

}


if(isTRUE(final_og$decision==final_new$decision && final_og$decision=="ambiguous")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s",final_og$decision))

}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision==final_new$decision && final_og$decision=="no signal")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s",final_og$decision))

}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision!=final_new$decision && final_new$decision=="sigmoidal")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  sigmoidalModel,
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s --> %s",final_og$decision,final_new$decision))

}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision!=final_new$decision && final_new$decision=="double_sigmoidal")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  doubleSigmoidalFitVector = doubleSigmoidalModel,
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s --> %s",final_og$decision,final_new$decision))

}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision!=final_new$decision && final_new$decision=="ambiguous")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s --> %s",final_og$decision,final_new$decision))

}

if(isTRUE(final_og$decision!=final_new$decision && final_new$decision=="no signal")){
    fig_b<-figureModelCurves(dataInput = dataInput,
                                  
                                  showParameterRelatedLines = TRUE,
                                  use_h0=TRUE)+
                                    labs(title=gene,subtitle=sprintf("%s --> %s",final_og$decision,final_new$decision))

}


results<-data.frame(final_og$decision,final_new$decision,final_new$test.F_test_sigmoid,final_new$test.F_test_ds,sigmoid_AIC=final_og$sigmoidalAIC,ds_AIC=final_og$doublesigmoidalAIC,
final_new$Flat_sigmoid_stat,
final_new$F_Flat_sigmoid_p_value,
final_new$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_stat,
final_new$lack_of_fit_sigmoid_p_value,
final_new$F_reject_sigmoid,
final_new$sigmoid_classic_fail,
final_new$sigmoid_lack_of_fit_fail,
final_new$sigmoid_AIC_fail,
final_new$Flat_ds_stat,
final_new$F_Flat_ds_p_value,
final_new$lack_of_fit_ds_stat,
final_new$lack_of_fit_ds_p_value,
final_new$F_reject_double,
final_new$double_classic_fail,
final_new$double_lack_of_fit_fail,
final_new$double_AIC_fail,
flipped
)

return(list(results=results,graph=fig_b))

}
```

```{r}
pdf("different_decision_cold.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

for (i in changes) {
  if (is.null(i)) next
  
  if (is.list(i) && !is.data.frame(i)) {
    results <- i$results
    graph   <- i$graph
  } else if (is.data.frame(i)) {
    results <- i
    graph   <- NULL 
  } else {
    next
  }
  
  if (!is.null(results) && nrow(results) > 0 && !is.null(graph)) {
    if (isTRUE(results[1, 1] != results[1, 2])) {
      print(graph)
    }
  }
}

dev.off()
```
